This article seems to pick almost exclusively on GOP candidates, and I'm not even convinced the cause is a good one. If you force congressmen to resign their seats in order to run, many who otherwise might give it a shot would probably rather keep their seat, which would result in less variety among presidential candidates. To me at least, having more choice is a good thing, even at the expense of a distracted representative.

Having said that, I do think that much stricter rules on where a congressman can travel if they want to bill the government for their expenses should be put in place. They should be allowed to bill for travel to and from their constituency only. That's what they were hired to do after all. Similarly, (IMHO) congressmen who miss more than a certain number of votes should be automatically recalled and a new election held. If they're unable to serve for whatever reason (even medical/family reasons) they should hand off the job to someone who can.

Swag Stickers is a soon to be launched online sticker retailer.

I am a recent business grad with an entrepreneurial spirit. I have been interested in starting my own business for some time now, and have had a couple half-hearted attempts getting my feet wet. The idea for this business in particular was more or less an accident. One night I was browsing the internet and, I honestly don't remember why, decided to see if the domain swagstickers.com was available. It was, so I bought it. Around this time, I had started a job as a graphic designer and was getting a lot of experience not only about design, but printing sources and marketing as well. All of the pieces of the puzzle just happened to fall into place.

While a sticker retailer is certainly not a unique idea, I do plan on doing some things differently than my competitors. The most important thing is price. If you take a look around the internet, you'll find it's hard to get a sticker for under ~$2.40 before shipping, and many places asking over $5 per sticker. Swag Stickers however will be offering stickers starting from just $1 and not going higher than $2. Keeping with the low cost theme, there will only be one shipping option available, and that's a stamp on an envelope, which will be $0.49 for people within the US and $1.15 for international customers. While this is somewhat risky, it's a risk I'm willing to take in order to keep overall order prices low. If something goes awry, we'll replace the order or refund it.

On top of the already competitive price, I plan on offering regular discount codes via social media. So it should not be difficult for customers to get their stickers for under $1.

Part of the reason the competition's prices are higher is that they allow anyone to come in and design their own sticker. While this is a nice service, it is not something Swag Stickers will be offering, or at least not yet. However, what I will be doing is seeking out artists with good or popular artwork and offer to pay them a royalty of stickers sold with their designs. The artist will be given an option of whether they would like their sticker sold at $1 or $2, with the royalty percentage adjusting accordingly. This will allow artists to benefit and be rewarded from their work without any extra effort on their part. I am still working on getting in touch with various artists, and have already made arrangements with a few. Most notably, we will be offering official Dickbutt stickers for our initial release. There will be 9 stickers available at the initial release, with at least 3 more designs available two weeks later. I hope to be able to maintain a similar pattern of releasing new designs, but will need to see how things pan out.

Swag Stickers is completely my own creation and I am funding it entirely myself. I have not done any sort of crowd funding nor acquired any investors. Aside from making fun, cheap stickers, my goal for Swag Stickers is to get more practice with running my own business, and hopefully grow it to the extent that it will be profitable enough for me to afford to return to school.

Swag Stickers is not available just yet, but will be June 1st. Until then, I will be having a giveaway event where 50 people will get all of our first round of stickers. The giveaway is here: http://swagstickerslaunch.kickoffpages.com/ and does require an email address to win.
